guide.title: Base shell
guide.text: Set the base shell (bag A) on the table with the battery cradle on the left.

guide.title: Battery
guide.text: Lay the battery (bag B) in the cradle and tuck its lead toward the middle.

guide.title: Main board
guide.text: Lower the main board (bag C) onto the four posts, USB-C port on the right, and fit the four screws.

guide.title: Sensor card
guide.text: Press the sensor card (bag D) into the header near the front edge. It only fits one way.

guide.title: Display
guide.text: Rest the display (bag E) on the four pillars and seat its ribbon in the connector.

guide.title: Top shell
guide.text: Fit the top shell (bag F) over everything and press the edges until it clicks.

# case.py: build123d (generated)
from build123d import *
BATTERY = (30, 25, 4.0)      # 2000 mAh pack, from interface spec
CORE    = (33, 22, 4.2)
WALL    = 1.4

with BuildPart() as bottom:
    Box(44, 38, 11.5)
    fillet(bottom.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), radius=9)
    offset(amount=-WALL, openings=bottom.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1])
    with Locations((0, 0, -2)):
        Box(*BATTERY, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)       # battery pocket
    with Locations((0, 0, -5.5)):
        Cylinder(3, WALL, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)   # USB-C notch

// monitor.ato: atopile (generated)
import NRF52840Module from "parts/nrf52840.ato"
import Display from "parts/display.ato"   // 1.3" OLED, 128×64
import LiPoPack from "parts/lipo.ato"

module Monitor:
    mcu = new NRF52840Module
    disp = new Display
    batt = new LiPoPack
    batt.capacity = 2000mAh
    mcu.spi ~ disp.spi
    mcu.vdd ~ power.v3v0     # 3.0 V rail, peak <= 45 mA
    assert power.v3v0.current_peak <= 45mA
